newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 7.34 pct at Italy lira repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 7.34 pct at Italy lira repo tender.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 11.0 trillion lire 16-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 7.34 percent, compared with 7.38 percent at the previous repo tender on March 24, the Bank said.
The average rate was 7.37 percent against 7.41 percent at the last repurchase pact for 10.0 trillion lire and 8 days.
The pact covers purchases today and the securities are for resale on April 11. The Bank said it received 39 bids of which 33 were met in full and two in part.
